keyMappings:
# Insert your preferred key mappings here.

# History
map <c-o> goBack
map <c-i> goForward

# Tab manipulation
map L nextTab
map H previousTab
map gbo closeOtherTabs
map gbr closeTabsOnRight
map gbH moveTabLeft
map gbL moveTabRight

# Scrolling
map <c-u> scrollPageUp
map <c-d> scrollPageDown

# Resets
unmap J
unmap K
unmap u
unmap d
unmap b
unmap t
unmap x
unmap r
unmap p
unmap P

# Disable omnibar
unmap o
unmap O
unmap b
unmap B
unmap T
unmap ge
unmap GE
